label: The state graph
subgoals: Enter Run-Test/Idle from Test-Logic-Reset with TMS at 0
Climb Select-DR-Scan and Select-IR-Scan with TMS at 1
Walk Capture, Shift, Exit1, Pause, Exit2 and Update in each column

label: Following a TMS sequence
subgoals: Apply one transition per TCK edge from the starting state
Read the final state after the last TMS value
Search the state graph breadth-first for the shortest path

label: Scan cycle counts
subgoals: Reach the Shift state from Run-Test/Idle in 3 edges for DR or 4 for IR
Shift the last bit on the edge that exits to Exit1
Return through Update to Run-Test/Idle in 2 more edges
